node.title: XR stage 1: generalized von Neumann — FM-excess controlled by iterated exchange energies
node.statement: Define E_k(u,v) rigorously as a k-fold iterated Johnson exchange energy and prove, with quantitative constants and endpoint control, that unpaid alignment excess over FM forces some E_k to be large. The exact k=2 fixed-slope moment is evidence but does not prove this multi-exchange reduction.
node.notes: SCOPE CORRECTION 2026-07-27: averaged_xr proves only the exact fixed-slope pair moment. The former packet leaves the iterated energies, Cauchy--Schwarz chain, and endpoint margin undefined, so this broader off-orbit claim is TARGET.
